cases.detail: Docstring begins 'Round a monetary amount to 2 decimal places using round-half-up.' and says 'exact halves round away from zero'. test_docstring_states_two_places_and_round_half_up passed.

cases.detail: QA added tests/test_round_currency.py (the Developer could not write under tests/). It covers positive exact half (2.345, 2.355, 0.005, 1.005), negative exact half (-2.345, -0.005), non-half (2.344, 2.346, -2.344) and <=2 decimals (2.34, 5, 0). All pass.
